/-- The room timeline: every stored PDU that is not an outlier. -/
def timeline (s : Snapshot) : List Pdu := s.pdus.val.filter (fun p => !p.outlier)

/-- Event ids, room ids and room short ids are keys. -/
def Keys (s : Snapshot) : Prop :=
  (s.pdus.val.map (fun p => p.event_id.val)).Nodup ∧
  (s.rooms.val.map (fun r => r.id.val)).Nodup ∧
  (s.rooms.val.map (fun r => r.short.val)).Nodup

spec.name: Visible
spec.code:
/-- tuwunel's rule (`user_can_see_event`) for user `u` asking in `room`:
an event with no recorded state is visible; otherwise the history visibility
in the state before the event decides:
- `world_readable`: anyone;
- `invited`: users invited or joined at the event;
- `joined`: users joined at the event;
- `shared`, or a value tuwunel does not know: users joined in `room` now,
  users joined at the event, and users who once joined `room` and whose
  latest leave is no earlier than the event. -/
def Visible (s : Snapshot) (u room e : Nat) : Prop :=
  match eventOf s e with
  | none => True
  | some p =>
    match p.state with
    | .None => True
    | .Hash h =>
      match visibilityAt s h.val with
      | .WorldReadable => True
      | .Invited => membershipAt s h.val u = .Join ∨ membershipAt s h.val u = .Invite
      | .Joined => membershipAt s h.val u = .Join
      | _ =>
        Joined s u room ∨ membershipAt s h.val u = .Join ∨
          (OnceJoined s u room ∧ ∃ l c, leftCount s u room = some l ∧ countOf s e = some c ∧ c ≤ toSigned l)

spec.name: Ignored
spec.code:
/-- `u` does not get `p`: dummy events, and message-like events from an
ignored user or a forbidden server. -/
def Ignored (s : Snapshot) (u : Nat) (p : Pdu) : Prop :=
  p.kind = .Dummy ∨
    (messageLike p.kind ∧
      (Forbidden s.config (p.sender.val / 1000) ∨ ∃ i ∈ s.ignored.val, i.user.val = u ∧ i.ignored.val = p.sender.val))

spec.name: eventOf
spec.code:
/-- The event with id `e`: its timeline row, else the outlier. -/
def eventOf (s : Snapshot) (e : Nat) : Option Pdu :=
  match (timeline s).find? (fun p => p.event_id.val = e) with
  | some p => some p
  | none => (s.pdus.val.filter (fun p => p.outlier)).find? (fun p => p.event_id.val = e)

spec.name: visibilityAt
spec.code:
/-- The history visibility in state snapshot `h`; none recorded, or content
that does not parse, counts as `shared`. -/
def visibilityAt (s : Snapshot) (h : Nat) : HistoryVisibility :=
  match stateLookup s h .HistoryVisibility 0 with
  | some p => match p.history_visibility with
    | .Is v => v
    | .Absent => .Shared
  | none => .Shared

spec.name: messageLike
spec.code:
/-- Event types a user's ignore list hides (`IGNORED_MESSAGE_TYPES`). -/
def messageLike : Kind → Bool
  | .Message | .Reaction | .Encrypted | .Sticker => true
  | _ => false

/-- A user's membership in state snapshot `h`; none recorded, or content
that does not parse, counts as `leave`. -/
def membershipAt (s : Snapshot) (h u : Nat) : Membership :=
  match stateLookup s h .Member u with
  | some p => match p.membership with
    | .Is m => m
    | .Absent => .Leave
  | none => .Leave

/-- [tuwunel_kernel::transition]:
    Source: 'src/lib.rs', lines 428:0-459:1
    Visibility: public -/
def transition
  (s : Snapshot) (req : Request) :
  Result (core.result.Result Reply Error)
  := do
  match req.op with
  | Op.Messages room «from» «to» dir limit filter =>
    api_message.get_message_events_route s req.user room «from» «to» dir
      limit filter
  | Op.Context room event limit filter =>
    api_context.get_context_route s req.user room event limit filter
  | Op.Relations room event rel_type event_type «from» «to» limit recurse
    dir =>
    api_relations.paginate_relations_with_filter s req.user room event
      event_type rel_type «from» «to» limit recurse dir
  | Op.Threads room «from» limit participated =>
    api_threads.get_threads_route s req.user room «from» limit participated
  | Op.State room => api_state.get_state_events_route s req.user room
  | Op.StateEvent room kind state_key =>
    api_state.get_state_events_for_key_route s req.user room kind state_key
  | Op.Members room «at» membership not_membership =>
    api_members.get_member_events_route s req.user room «at» membership
      not_membership
  | Op.JoinedMembers room => api_members.joined_members_route s req.user room
  | Op.InitialSync room limit =>
    api_room.room_initial_sync_route s req.user room limit
  | Op.RoomEvent room event =>
    api_room.get_room_event_route s req.user room event
  | Op.ServerCanSee origin room event =>
    let b ← svc_accessor.server_can_see_event s origin room event
    ok (core.result.Result.Ok (Reply.CanSee b))

/-- [tuwunel_kernel::api_room::get_room_event_route]:
    Source: 'src/api_room.rs', lines 121:0-135:1
    Visibility: public -/
def api_room.get_room_event_route
  (s : Snapshot) (user : Std.U64) (room : Std.U64) (event_id : Std.U64) :
  Result (core.result.Result Reply Error)
  := do
  let event ← svc_timeline.get_pdu s event_id
  let visible ← svc_accessor.user_can_see_event s user room event_id
  match event with
  | core.result.Result.Ok p =>
    if visible
    then
      let p1 ←
        alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice Pdu) 
          s.pdus p
      let b ← api_message.is_ignored_pdu s p1 user
      if b
      then ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.SenderIgnored)
      else ok (core.result.Result.Ok (Reply.RoomEvent p1.event_id))
    else ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.NotFound)
  | core.result.Result.Err _ => ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.NotFound)

/-- [tuwunel_kernel::api_members::get_member_events_route]:
    Source: 'src/api_members.rs', lines 18:0-62:1
    Visibility: public -/
def api_members.get_member_events_route
  (s : Snapshot) (user : Std.U64) (room : Std.U64) («at» : Token)
  (membership : Option Membership) (not_membership : Option Membership) :
  Result (core.result.Result Reply Error)
  := do
  let b ← svc_accessor.user_can_see_state_events s user room
  if b
  then
    match «at» with
    | Token.Absent =>
      let r ← svc_timeline.get_room_shortstatehash s room
      match r with
      | core.result.Result.Ok h =>
        let v ← svc_accessor.state_full s h
        let chunk ←
          api_members.get_member_events_route_loop0 s membership not_membership
            v (alloc.vec.Vec.new Std.U64) 0#usize
        ok (core.result.Result.Ok (Reply.Members chunk))
      | core.result.Result.Err _ => ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.Database)
    | Token.At c =>
      let r ← svc_timeline.shortstatehash_after s room c
      match r with
      | core.result.Result.Ok h =>
        let v ← svc_accessor.state_full s h
        let chunk ←
          api_members.get_member_events_route_loop1 s membership not_membership
            v (alloc.vec.Vec.new Std.U64) 0#usize
        ok (core.result.Result.Ok (Reply.Members chunk))
      | core.result.Result.Err e => ok (core.result.Result.Err e)
    | Token.Invalid => ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.InvalidParam)
  else ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.Forbidden)

import Spec
import I5hLib
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result tuwunel_kernel tuwunel_kernel.Spec I5hLib

namespace tuwunel_kernel.Solution

attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000

@[simp] theorem scalar_eq (x y : U64) : x = y ↔ x.val = y.val := (u64_val_eq x y).symm
attribute [-simp] List.find?_eq_none
attribute [simp] alloc.vec.Vec.deref

def lookupAbs {α : Type} (l : List α) : core.result.Result Usize Error → Option α × Bool
  | .Ok i => (l[i.val]?, true)
  | .Err _ => (none, false)

def Lookup {α : Type} (l : List α) (o : Option α) (r : core.result.Result Usize Error) : Prop :=
  lookupAbs l r = (o, o.isSome)

theorem lookup_search {α : Type} (l : List α) (pred : α → Bool)
    (body : Usize → Result (ControlFlow Usize (core.result.Result Usize Error)))
    (hs : ∀ i, i.val ≤ l.length → body i ⦃
      SearchStep l pred (lookupAbs l) (fun _ x => (some x, true)) (none, false) i ⦄) :
    loop body 0#usize ⦃ Lookup l (l.find? pred) ⦄ := by
  apply WP.spec_mono (loop_search l pred (lookupAbs l)
    (fun _ x => (some x, true)) (none, false) body hs 0#usize (by simp))
  intro r hr
  rw [searchFrom_findD] at hr
  simp only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq, List.drop_zero] at hr
  unfold Lookup
  rw [hr]
  cases l.find? pred <;> rfl

theorem lookup_index {α : Type} {l : List α} {o : Option α} {i : Usize}
    (h : Lookup l o (.Ok i)) : ∃ hi : i.val < l.length, o = some l[i.val] := by
  unfold Lookup lookupAbs at h
  have he := (Prod.mk.inj h).1
  have ht := (Prod.mk.inj h).2
  cases o with
  | none => simp at ht
  | some p =>
    obtain ⟨hi, hp⟩ := List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.1 he
    exact ⟨hi, congrArg some hp.symm⟩

@[step] theorem non_outlier_spec (s : Snapshot) (e : U64) :
    svc_timeline.get_non_outlier s e ⦃ Lookup s.pdus.val
      ((timeline s).find? (fun p => p.event_id.val = e.val)) ⦄ := by
  unfold svc_timeline.get_non_outlier svc_timeline.get_non_outlier_loop
  have hm : (timeline s).find? (fun p => p.event_id.val = e.val) =
      s.pdus.val.find? (fun p => !p.outlier && decide (p.event_id = e)) := by
    simp [timeline, List.find?_filter, Bool.and_comm]
  rw [hm]
  apply lookup_search
  intro i hi
  unfold svc_timeline.get_non_outlier_loop.body
  i5h_step [lookupAbs, List.getElem?_eq_getElem]

@[step] theorem outlier_spec (s : Snapshot) (e : U64) :
    svc_timeline.get_outlier s e ⦃ Lookup s.pdus.val
      ((s.pdus.val.filter (fun p => p.outlier)).find? (fun p => p.event_id.val = e.val)) ⦄ := by
  unfold svc_timeline.get_outlier svc_timeline.get_outlier_loop
  have hm : (s.pdus.val.filter (fun p => p.outlier)).find? (fun p => p.event_id.val = e.val) =
      s.pdus.val.find? (fun p => p.outlier && decide (p.event_id = e)) := by
    simp [List.find?_filter, Bool.and_comm]
  rw [hm]
  apply lookup_search
  intro i hi
  unfold svc_timeline.get_outlier_loop.body
  i5h_step [lookupAbs, List.getElem?_eq_getElem]

@[step] theorem pdu_spec (s : Snapshot) (e : U64) :
    svc_timeline.get_pdu s e ⦃ Lookup s.pdus.val (eventOf s e.val) ⦄ := by
  unfold svc_timeline.get_pdu
  step
  cases hf : (timeline s).find? (fun p => p.event_id.val = e.val) <;>
    cases r <;> simp_all [Lookup, lookupAbs, eventOf]
  step* <;> simp_all [Lookup, lookupAbs, eventOf]

@[step] theorem state_set_spec (s : Snapshot) (hash : U64) :
    svc_accessor.load_full_state s hash ⦃ Lookup s.states.val
      (s.states.val.find? (fun ss => ss.hash.val = hash.val)) ⦄ := by
  unfold svc_accessor.load_full_state svc_accessor.load_full_state_loop
  have hm : (fun ss : StateSet => decide (ss.hash.val = hash.val)) =
      (fun ss => decide (ss.hash = hash)) := by funext ss; simp
  rw [hm]
  apply lookup_search
  intro i hi
  unfold svc_accessor.load_full_state_loop.body
  i5h_step [lookupAbs, List.getElem?_eq_getElem]

def valueAbs {α : Type} : core.result.Result α Error → Option α
  | .Ok x => some x
  | .Err _ => none

theorem value_search {α β : Type} (l : List α) (pred : α → Bool) (f : α → β)
    (body : Usize → Result (ControlFlow Usize (core.result.Result β Error)))
    (hs : ∀ i, i.val ≤ l.length → body i ⦃
      SearchStep l pred valueAbs (fun _ x => some (f x)) none i ⦄) :
    loop body 0#usize ⦃ r => valueAbs r = (l.find? pred).map f ⦄ := by
  apply WP.spec_mono (loop_search l pred valueAbs (fun _ x => some (f x)) none
    body hs 0#usize (by simp))
  intro r hr
  simpa [searchFrom_find] using hr

@[step] theorem kind_eq_spec (a b : Kind) : kind_eq a b ⦃ r => r = decide (a = b) ⦄ := by
  cases a <;> cases b <;> simp [kind_eq]

@[step] theorem entry_spec (entries : Slice StateEntry) (kind : Kind) (key : U64) :
    svc_accessor.find_entry entries kind key ⦃ r => valueAbs r =
      (entries.val.find? (fun en => en.kind = kind ∧ en.state_key.val = key.val)).map (·.event_id) ⦄ := by
  unfold svc_accessor.find_entry svc_accessor.find_entry_loop
  apply value_search
  intro i hi
  unfold svc_accessor.find_entry_loop.body
  i5h_step [valueAbs]

theorem lookup_err {α : Type} {l : List α} {o : Option α} {err : Error}
    (h : Lookup l o (.Err err)) : o = none := by
  have he := (Prod.mk.inj h).1
  exact he.symm

@[step] theorem state_get_spec (s : Snapshot) (hash : U64) (kind : Kind) (key : U64) :
    svc_accessor.state_get s hash kind key ⦃ Lookup s.pdus.val (stateLookup s hash.val kind key.val) ⦄ := by
  unfold svc_accessor.state_get svc_accessor.state_get_id
  step
  cases r with
  | Err err =>
    have hn := lookup_err r_post
    simp [stateLookup, stateEntries, hn, Lookup, lookupAbs]
  | Ok idx =>
    obtain ⟨hi, hm⟩ := lookup_index r_post
    step as ⟨ss, hss⟩
    subst ss
    step as ⟨r, hr⟩
    cases r with
    | Err err =>
      simp_all [stateLookup, stateEntries, Lookup, lookupAbs, valueAbs]
    | Ok eid =>
      simp only [valueAbs] at hr
      obtain ⟨entry, he, hid⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hr.symm
      step*
      simp_all [stateLookup, stateEntries, Lookup, lookupAbs, valueAbs]

@[step] theorem membership_spec (s : Snapshot) (hash user : U64) :
    svc_accessor.user_membership s hash user ⦃ m => m = membershipAt s hash.val user.val ⦄ := by
  unfold svc_accessor.user_membership
  step
  cases r with
  | Err err =>
    have hn := lookup_err r_post
    simp [membershipAt, hn]
  | Ok idx =>

@[step] theorem hv_spec (s : Snapshot) (hash : U64) :
    svc_accessor.history_visibility_at s hash ⦃ hv => hv = visibilityAt s hash.val ⦄ := by
  unfold svc_accessor.history_visibility_at

  cases r with
  | Err err =>
    have hn := lookup_err r_post
    simp [visibilityAt, hn]
  | Ok idx =>

@[step] theorem was_joined_spec (s : Snapshot) (hash user : U64) :
    svc_accessor.user_was_joined s hash user ⦃ b => b = decide (membershipAt s hash.val user.val = .Join) ⦄ := by
  unfold svc_accessor.user_was_joined

@[step] theorem was_invited_spec (s : Snapshot) (hash user : U64) :

theorem any_search {α : Type} (l : List α) (pred : α → Bool)
    (body : Usize → Result (ControlFlow Usize Bool))
    (hs : ∀ i, i.val ≤ l.length → body i ⦃
      SearchStep l pred id (fun _ _ => true) false i ⦄) :
    loop body 0#usize ⦃ b => b = l.any pred ⦄ := by
  apply WP.spec_mono (loop_search l pred id (fun _ _ => true) false body hs 0#usize (by simp))

@[step] theorem has_row_spec (rows : Slice UserRoom) (user room : U64) :
    svc_cache.has_row rows user room ⦃ b => b = decide
      (∃ x ∈ rows.val, x.user.val = user.val ∧ x.room.val = room.val) ⦄ := by

theorem index_ok {α : Type} (v : alloc.vec.Vec α) (i : Usize) (p : α)
    (h : alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice α) v i = ok p) :
    v.val[i.val]? = some p := by
  simp only [alloc.vec.Vec.index, core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice,
    alloc.vec.Vec.index_usize, Slice.index_usize] at h
  change (match v.val[i.val]? with | none => fail .arrayOutOfBounds | some x => ok x) = ok p at h
  cases he : v.val[i.val]? <;> simp_all

theorem pdu_count_ok (s : Snapshot) (e : U64) (count : I64)
    (h : svc_timeline.get_pdu_count s e = ok (.Ok count)) :
    countOf s e.val = some count.val := by
  unfold svc_timeline.get_pdu_count at h
  obtain ⟨res, hres, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 h
  cases res with
  | Err err => simp at h
  | Ok pair =>
    obtain ⟨short, count'⟩ := pair
    change ok (core.result.Result.Ok count' : core.result.Result I64 Error) = ok (core.result.Result.Ok count) at h
    simp only [Result.ok.injEq, core.result.Result.Ok.injEq] at h
    subst count'
    unfold svc_timeline.get_pdu_id at hres
    i5h_invert hres
    subst_vars
    have hl := post_of_ok (non_outlier_spec s e) (by assumption)
    obtain ⟨hi, hm⟩ := lookup_index hl
    have hp := index_ok s.pdus _ _ (by assumption)
    simp only [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hi, Option.some.injEq] at hp
    subst_vars
    simp [countOf, hm]

theorem signed_cast (left : U64) : (UScalar.hcast .I64 left).val = toSigned left.val := by
  rw [UScalar.hcast_val_eq]
  have hb : left.val < 2 ^ 64 := by scalar_tac
  simp only [IScalarTy.numBits, Int.bmod_eq_emod, toSigned]
  have hm : (left.val : Int) % (2 ^ 64 : Nat) = left.val := by
    apply Int.emod_eq_of_lt <;> omega
  rw [hm]
  split <;> split <;> omega

theorem shared_ok (s : Snapshot) (hash room e user : U64)
    (h : svc_accessor.user_shared_history s hash room e user = ok true) :
    Joined s user.val room.val ∨ membershipAt s hash.val user.val = .Join ∨
      (OnceJoined s user.val room.val ∧ ∃ left count,
        leftCount s user.val room.val = some left ∧ countOf s e.val = some count ∧ count ≤ toSigned left) := by
  unfold svc_accessor.user_shared_history at h
  i5h_invert h
  all_goals subst_vars
  all_goals
    first
    | (left; have hb := post_of_ok (joined_spec s user room) (by assumption); simpa using hb.symm)
    | (right; left; have hb := post_of_ok (was_joined_spec s hash user) (by assumption); simpa using hb.symm)
    | (right; right
       have hb := post_of_ok (once_joined_spec s user room) (by assumption)
       refine ⟨by simpa using hb.symm, ?_⟩
       have hl := post_of_ok (left_spec s room user) (by assumption)
       have hc := pdu_count_ok s e _ (by assumption)
       simp only [valueAbs, Option.map_some] at hl
       refine ⟨_, _, hl.symm, hc, ?_⟩
       simp only [lift, Result.ok.injEq] at *
       subst_vars
       simp_all [signed_cast])

@[step] theorem state_hash_spec (s : Snapshot) (e : U64) :
    svc_timeline.pdu_shortstatehash s e ⦃ r => valueAbs r =
      (eventOf s e.val).bind (fun p => match p.state with | .None => none | .Hash hash => some hash) ⦄ := by
  unfold svc_timeline.pdu_shortstatehash
  step
  cases r with
  | Err err =>
    have hn := lookup_err r_post
    simp [hn, valueAbs]
  | Ok idx =>
    obtain ⟨hi, hm⟩ := lookup_index r_post
    step*
    unfold svc_timeline.state_of
    split <;> simp_all [valueAbs]

theorem see_ok (s : Snapshot) (user room e : U64)
    (h : svc_accessor.user_can_see_event s user room e = ok true) :
    Visible s user.val room.val e.val := by
  unfold svc_accessor.user_can_see_event at h
  i5h_invert h
  all_goals
    have hs := post_of_ok (state_hash_spec s e) (by assumption)
    simp only [valueAbs] at hs
    unfold Visible
    cases he : eventOf s e.val with
    | none => trivial
    | some p =>
      cases hp : p.state with
      | None => simp [hp]
      | Hash hash =>
        simp only [hp]
        simp only [he, hp, Option.bind_some] at hs
        all_goals
          simp -failIfUnchanged only [reduceCtorEq, Option.some.injEq] at hs
          all_goals
            subst_vars
            have hv := post_of_ok (hv_spec s hash) (by assumption)
            rw [← hv]
            first
            | trivial
            | exact shared_ok s hash room e user (by assumption)
            | (have hm := post_of_ok (was_invited_spec s hash user) (by assumption); simpa using hm.symm)
            | (have hm := post_of_ok (was_joined_spec s hash user) (by assumption); simpa using hm.symm)

@[step] theorem contains_spec (v : Slice U64) (x : U64) :
    contains_u64 v x ⦃ b => b = decide (∃ y ∈ v.val, y.val = x.val) ⦄ := by
  unfold contains_u64 contains_u64_loop
  apply WP.spec_mono (any_search v.val (fun y => decide (y.val = x.val)) _ ?_)
  · intro b hb
    rw [hb]
    apply Bool.eq_iff_iff.2
    simp only [List.any_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
  · intro i hi
    unfold contains_u64_loop.body
    i5h_step

@[step] theorem forbidden_spec (c : Config) (server : U64) :
    filters.is_forbidden_remote_server_name c server ⦃ b => b = decide (Forbidden c server.val) ⦄ := by
  unfold filters.is_forbidden_remote_server_name
  i5h_steps <;> apply Bool.eq_iff_iff.2 <;>
    simp_all [Forbidden, alloc.vec.Vec.len, usize_ofNatCore_eq_zero,
      bne_iff_ne, List.length_eq_zero_iff]

@[step] theorem ignored_user_spec (s : Snapshot) (sender user : U64) :
    api_message.user_is_ignored s sender user ⦃ b => b = decide
      (∃ row ∈ s.ignored.val, row.user.val = user.val ∧ row.ignored.val = sender.val) ⦄ := by
  unfold api_message.user_is_ignored api_message.user_is_ignored_loop
  apply WP.spec_mono (any_search s.ignored.val
    (fun row => decide (row.user.val = user.val ∧ row.ignored.val = sender.val)) _ ?_)
  · intro b hb
    rw [hb]
    apply Bool.eq_iff_iff.2
    simp only [List.any_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
  · intro i hi
    unfold api_message.user_is_ignored_loop.body
    i5h_step

@[step] theorem server_spec (sender : U64) :
    server_name sender ⦃ server => server.val = sender.val / 1000 ⦄ := by
  unfold server_name
  step* <;> scalar_tac

@[step] theorem ignored_pdu_spec (s : Snapshot) (p : Pdu) (user : U64) :
    api_message.is_ignored_pdu s p user ⦃ b => b = decide (Ignored s user.val p) ⦄ := by
  unfold api_message.is_ignored_pdu
  cases hk : p.kind <;>
    simp only [bind_tc_ok] <;>
    unfold api_message.is_ignored_message_type <;>
    i5h_steps <;> try (apply Bool.eq_iff_iff.2) <;> simp_all [Ignored, messageLike]

theorem filters_ok (s : Snapshot) (user : U64) (idx : Usize)
    (h : api_message.event_filters s user idx false = ok true) :
    ∃ p, s.pdus.val[idx.val]? = some p ∧ ¬ Ignored s user.val p ∧
      Visible s user.val p.room.val p.event_id.val := by
  unfold api_message.event_filters at h
  simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, reduceIte] at h
  i5h_invert h
  subst_vars
  have hg : api_message.ignored_filter s idx user = ok true := by assumption
  unfold api_message.ignored_filter at hg
  i5h_invert hg
  subst_vars
  have hp := index_ok s.pdus idx _ (by assumption)
  have hv : api_message.visibility_filter s idx user = ok true := by assumption
  unfold api_message.visibility_filter at hv
  i5h_invert hv
  have hq := index_ok s.pdus idx _ (by assumption)
  have he := Option.some.inj (hp.symm.trans hq)
  subst_vars
  have hn := post_of_ok (ignored_pdu_spec s _ user) (by assumption)
  refine ⟨_, hp, ?_, see_ok s user _ _ (by assumption)⟩
  simp_all

theorem passes_ok (s : Snapshot) (user : U64) (f : Filter) (short : U64) (count : I64) (idx : Usize)
    (h : api_message.passes s user f short count idx false = ok true) :
    ∃ p, s.pdus.val[idx.val]? = some p ∧ ¬ Ignored s user.val p ∧
      Visible s user.val p.room.val p.event_id.val := by
  unfold api_message.passes at h
  i5h_invert h
  exact filters_ok s user idx h

theorem push_ok {α : Type} (v : alloc.vec.Vec α) (x : α) (out : alloc.vec.Vec α)
    (h : alloc.vec.Vec.push v x = ok out) : out.val = v.val ++ [x] := by
  unfold alloc.vec.Vec.push at h
  dsimp only at h
  split at h <;> simp_all
  subst out
  simp only [alloc.vec.Vec.from_val]

theorem add_one_ok (idx next : Usize) (h : idx + 1#usize = ok next) : next.val = idx.val + 1 := by
  have he := UScalar.add_equiv idx 1#usize
  rw [h] at he
  exact he.2.1

theorem sub_one_ok (idx next : Usize) (h : idx - 1#usize = ok next) : next.val = idx.val - 1 := by
  have he := UScalar.sub_equiv idx 1#usize
  rw [h] at he
  have hv := he.2.1
  change idx.val = next.val + 1 at hv
  omega

def RoomIdx (s : Snapshot) (room : U64) (idx : Usize) : Prop :=
  ∃ p, s.pdus.val[idx.val]? = some p ∧ p.outlier = false ∧ p.room.val = room.val

def RoomIndices (s : Snapshot) (room : U64) (out : alloc.vec.Vec Usize) : Prop :=
  ∀ idx ∈ out.val, RoomIdx s room idx

@[step] theorem in_timeline_spec (p : Pdu) (room : U64) :
    svc_timeline.in_timeline p room ⦃ b => b = decide (p.outlier = false ∧ p.room.val = room.val) ⦄ := by
  unfold svc_timeline.in_timeline
  split <;> simp_all

theorem pdus_loop_ok (s : Snapshot) (room : U64) (frm : I64)
    (out : alloc.vec.Vec Usize) (idx : Usize) (result : alloc.vec.Vec Usize)
    (hout : RoomIndices s room out)
    (h : svc_timeline.pdus_loop s room frm out idx = ok result) : RoomIndices s room result := by
  unfold svc_timeline.pdus_loop at h
  apply loop_ok _ (fun state => RoomIndices s room state.1)
    (RoomIndices s room) (fun state => s.pdus.val.length - state.2.val) ?_ (out, idx) result hout h
  rintro ⟨acc, pos⟩ res hacc hb
  unfold svc_timeline.pdus_loop.body at hb
  simp only [bind_tc_ite, bind_ite] at hb
  i5h_invert hb
  all_goals subst_vars
  all_goals try exact hacc
  all_goals
    have ha := add_one_ok pos _ (by assumption)
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · first
      | exact hacc
      | (have hp := index_ok s.pdus pos _ (by assumption)
         have ht := post_of_ok (in_timeline_spec _ room) (by assumption)
         have hv := push_ok acc pos _ (by assumption)
         simp only [decide_eq_true_eq, true_eq_decide_iff] at ht
         intro entry he
         rw [hv] at he
         simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton] at he
         rcases he with he | rfl
         · exact hacc entry he
         · exact ⟨_, hp, ht⟩)
    · simp only
      scalar_tac

theorem pdus_rev_loop_ok (s : Snapshot) (room : U64) (upto : I64)
    (out : alloc.vec.Vec Usize) (idx : Usize) (result : alloc.vec.Vec Usize)
    (hout : RoomIndices s room out)
    (h : svc_timeline.pdus_rev_loop s.pdus room upto out idx = ok result) : RoomIndices s room result := by
  unfold svc_timeline.pdus_rev_loop at h
  apply loop_ok _ (fun state => RoomIndices s room state.1)
    (RoomIndices s room) (fun state => state.2.val) ?_ (out, idx) result hout h
  rintro ⟨acc, pos⟩ res hacc hb
  unfold svc_timeline.pdus_rev_loop.body at hb
  i5h_invert hb
  all_goals subst_vars
  all_goals try exact hacc
  all_goals
    have ha := sub_one_ok pos _ (by assumption)
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · first
      | exact hacc
      | (have hp := index_ok s.pdus _ _ (by assumption)
         have ht := post_of_ok (in_timeline_spec _ room) (by assumption)
         have hv := push_ok acc _ _ (by assumption)
         simp only [decide_eq_true_eq, true_eq_decide_iff] at ht
         intro entry he
         rw [hv] at he
         simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton] at he
         rcases he with he | rfl
         · exact hacc entry he
         · exact ⟨_, hp, ht⟩)
    · simp only
      scalar_tac

theorem pdus_ok (s : Snapshot) (room : U64) (frm : I64) (out : alloc.vec.Vec Usize)
    (h : svc_timeline.pdus s room frm = ok (.Ok out)) : RoomIndices s room out := by
  unfold svc_timeline.pdus at h
  i5h_invert h
  subst_vars
  exact pdus_loop_ok s room frm (alloc.vec.Vec.new Usize) 0#usize out (by simp [RoomIndices]) h

theorem pdus_rev_ok (s : Snapshot) (room : U64) (upto : I64) (out : alloc.vec.Vec Usize)
    (h : svc_timeline.pdus_rev s room upto = ok (.Ok out)) : RoomIndices s room out := by
  unfold svc_timeline.pdus_rev at h
  i5h_invert h
  subst_vars
  exact pdus_rev_loop_ok s room upto (alloc.vec.Vec.new Usize) (alloc.vec.Vec.len s.pdus) out
    (by simp [RoomIndices]) h

def SafeEvent (s : Snapshot) (user room : U64) (e : U64) : Prop :=
  InRoom s room.val e.val ∧ Visible s user.val room.val e.val ∧
    ∀ p ∈ timeline s, p.event_id = e → ¬ Ignored s user.val p

def SafeIdx (s : Snapshot) (user room : U64) (idx : Usize) : Prop :=
  ∃ p, s.pdus.val[idx.val]? = some p ∧ SafeEvent s user room p.event_id

def SafeIndices (s : Snapshot) (user room : U64) (events : alloc.vec.Vec (I64 × Usize)) : Prop :=
  ∀ pair ∈ events.val, SafeIdx s user room pair.2

theorem safe_idx (s : Snapshot) (user room : U64) (idx : Usize) (hk : Keys s)
    (hr : RoomIdx s room idx)
    (hf : ∃ p, s.pdus.val[idx.val]? = some p ∧ ¬ Ignored s user.val p ∧
      Visible s user.val p.room.val p.event_id.val) : SafeIdx s user room idx := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hout, hroom⟩ := hr
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hn, hv⟩ := hf
  have he := Option.some.inj (hp.symm.trans hq)
  subst q
  have hmem := List.mem_of_getElem? hp
  have ht : p ∈ timeline s := by simp [timeline, hmem, hout]
  refine ⟨p, hp, ⟨⟨p, ht, rfl, hroom⟩, hroom ▸ hv, ?_⟩⟩
  intro other hother hid
  have hm : other ∈ s.pdus.val := (List.mem_filter.1 hother).1
  have heq := List.inj_on_of_nodup_map hk.1 hm hmem (congrArg UScalar.val hid)
  simpa [heq] using hn

theorem slice_index_ok {α : Type} (v : Slice α) (idx : Usize) (p : α)
    (h : Slice.index_usize v idx = ok p) : v.val[idx.val]? = some p := by
  unfold Slice.index_usize at h
  cases he : v.val[idx.val]? <;> simp_all

theorem scan_ok (s : Snapshot) (user room : U64) (it : Slice Usize)
    (upto : Option I64) (dir : Dir) (limit : U64) (filter : Filter) (short : U64)
    (result : alloc.vec.Vec (I64 × Usize) × Option I64) (hk : Keys s)
    (hit : ∀ idx ∈ it.val, RoomIdx s room idx)
    (h : api_message.scan s user it upto dir limit filter short false = ok result) :
    SafeIndices s user room result.1 := by
  unfold api_message.scan api_message.scan_loop at h
  apply loop_ok _ (fun state => SafeIndices s user room state.1)
    (fun res => SafeIndices s user room res.1)
    (fun state => 2 * (it.val.length - state.2.2.2.val) + if state.2.2.1 then 0 else 1)
    ?_ _ result (by simp [SafeIndices]) h
  rintro ⟨acc, scanned, stopped, pos⟩ res hacc hb
  unfold api_message.scan_loop.body at hb
  simp only [bind_tc_ite, bind_ite] at hb
  i5h_invert hb
  all_goals subst_vars
  all_goals try exact hacc
  all_goals
    try have ha := add_one_ok pos _ (by assumption)
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · first
      | exact hacc
      | (have hp := slice_index_ok it pos _ (by assumption)
         have hr := hit _ (List.mem_of_getElem? hp)
         have hf := passes_ok s user filter short _ _ (by assumption)
         have hs := safe_idx s user room _ hk hr hf
         have hv := push_ok acc _ _ (by assumption)
         intro pair he
         rw [hv] at he
         simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton] at he
         rcases he with he | rfl
         · exact hacc pair he
         · exact hs)
    · simp only
      scalar_tac

theorem event_ids_ok (s : Snapshot) (user room : U64) (events : Slice (I64 × Usize))
    (out : alloc.vec.Vec U64)
    (hs : ∀ pair ∈ events.val, SafeIdx s user room pair.2)
    (h : api_message.event_ids s events = ok out) : ∀ e ∈ out.val, SafeEvent s user room e := by
  unfold api_message.event_ids api_message.event_ids_loop at h
  apply loop_ok _ (fun state => ∀ e ∈ state.1.val, SafeEvent s user room e)
    (fun result => ∀ e ∈ result.val, SafeEvent s user room e)
    (fun state => events.val.length - state.2.val) ?_ _ out (by simp) h
  rintro ⟨acc, pos⟩ res hacc hb
  unfold api_message.event_ids_loop.body at hb
  i5h_invert hb
  all_goals subst_vars
  all_goals try exact hacc
  rename_i pair hpair
  obtain ⟨count, idx⟩ := pair
  change (do
    let p ← alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice Pdu) s.pdus idx
    let next ← alloc.vec.Vec.push acc p.event_id
    let pos' ← pos + 1#usize
    ok (.cont (next, pos'))) = ok res at hb
  i5h_invert hb
  subst_vars
  have ha := add_one_ok pos _ (by assumption)
  have hp := slice_index_ok events pos _ (by assumption)
  have hi := hs _ (List.mem_of_getElem? hp)
  obtain ⟨p, hpidx, hsafe⟩ := hi
  have hq := index_ok s.pdus _ _ (by assumption)
  have he := Option.some.inj (hpidx.symm.trans hq)
  subst_vars
  have hv := push_ok acc _ _ (by assumption)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro e he
    rw [hv] at he
    simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton] at he
    rcases he with he | rfl
    · exact hacc e he
    · exact hsafe
  · simp only
    scalar_tac

theorem messages_visible (s : Snapshot) (u room : U64) (frm upto : Token) (dir : Dir) (lim : U64) (f : Filter)
    (st : I64) (en : Option I64) (chunk : alloc.vec.Vec U64)
    (h : transition s ⟨u, .Messages room frm upto dir lim f⟩ = ok (.Ok (.Messages st en chunk)))
    (hk : Keys s) :
    ∀ e ∈ chunk.val, InRoom s room.val e.val ∧ Visible s u.val room.val e.val ∧
      ∀ p ∈ timeline s, p.event_id = e → ¬ Ignored s u.val p := by
  change ∀ e ∈ chunk.val, SafeEvent s u room e
  change api_message.get_messages s u room frm upto dir (some lim) f false =
    ok (.Ok (.Messages st en chunk)) at h
  cases frm <;> cases upto <;> cases dir <;>
    unfold api_message.get_messages at h <;>
    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, reduceIte] at h <;>
    i5h_invert h
  all_goals
    rename_i rshort short hshort result hscan
    obtain ⟨events, scanned⟩ := result
    rename_i it hiteq
    rename_i iter hiter
    cases iter <;> simp only [Result.ok.injEq] at hiteq <;> subst it
  all_goals
    have hs : SafeIndices s u room events := by
      refine scan_ok s u room _ _ _ _ _ _ (events, scanned) hk ?_ hscan
      first
      | simpa [RoomIndices] using (pdus_ok s room _ _ hiter)
      | simpa [RoomIndices] using (pdus_rev_ok s room _ _ hiter)
      | simp
    change (do
      let stopped : Bool ← _
      let backward : Bool ← _
      let exhausted : Bool ← _
      let next_token : Option I64 ← _
      let ids ← api_message.event_ids s events.deref
      ok (core.result.Result.Ok (Reply.Messages _ next_token ids))) =
      ok (core.result.Result.Ok (Reply.Messages st en chunk)) at h
    i5h_invert h
    all_goals
      subst_vars
      exact event_ids_ok s u room events.deref chunk
        (by simpa [SafeIndices] using hs) (by assumption)

end tuwunel_kernel.Solution
